name: Germinated Mandragora
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-05: The Island of the Vibrant Dead

generalAbilities.name: Blood Scent
generalAbilities.description: A germinated mandragora can smell creatures with blood as an imprecise scent at a range of 30 feet, and it can smell demons, fey, and sorcerers with blood as a precise sense at a range of 30 feet.

defensiveAbilities.name: Vulnerability to Supernatural Darkness
defensiveAbilities.description: Whenever a germinated mandragora begins its turn in an area of magical darkness, it is Slowed 1 on that turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blood Drain
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The germinated mandragora has a creature Grabbed

Effect The germinated mandragora drains blood from the creature it has grabbed, dealing 1d6 Untyped Damage damage. If the creature is a demon, fey, or sorcerer, the germinated mandragora gains temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt. A creature that has its blood drained by a germinated mandragora is Drained 1 until it receives healing of any kind or amount.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mandragora Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 19 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 Poison Damage damage and Stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 Poison Damage damage, Confused, and Stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 2d6 Poison Damage damage, Confused, and Stupefied 1 (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Piercing Shriek
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The germinated mandragora emits an unsettling shriek. Each non-mandragora creature within 30 feet must attempt a DC 23 Will Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Sickened 1.

Failure The creature is Sickened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is sickened 2 and Slowed 1. As long as the creature remains sickened, this slowed condition value can't be reduced below 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
